title: IMA welcomes rank-based system in Neet, seeks safeguards to protect merit
description:
The Indian Medical Association (IMA) on Wednesday called for safeguards to ensure that merit and minimum academic standards are not compromised in postgraduate medical admissions, saying the NMC's proposed shift to a rank-based system for NEET-PG and NEET-SS should not become a means of filling vacant seats at the cost of merit and patient safety.
The National Medical Commission (NMC) has given in-principle approval to replacing the existing percentile-based system with a rank-based merit system for admissions to postgraduate and super-speciality medical courses. Under the proposed arrangement, only ranks, and not percentile scores, will be declared in examination results.
The proposed system is yet to be notified through final NMC regulations. A draft regulation is expected to be issued for stakeholder consultation.
